en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Kaede...I'm sorry.
I'm not strong enough for this!
<CLT=cltMIND>I can't make you the culprit!

W-Well, actually... Maybe the shot
didn't pass through the vent...

Did you not just tell us that the
shot traveled through the vent?

That's true, but...I just remembered,
the library's vent was closed.
The vent...was closed?
So I think...my deduction might be wrong.
Shuichi?
I see...

Shuichi, we both investigated the vent.
But you misunderstood something.
...What?

I closed the vent grate while we were
investigating, but it was open before.

Does this mean Shuichi's testimony was based
on a misunderstanding?
No... That's a lie!

It's not a lie.
But depending on your deduction...
it could <CLT=cltSTRONG>become a lie<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Shuichi, please, answer the question.
How did the shot reach Rantaro?

You know the answer.
You just heard it during the debate.
<CLT=cltMIND>Why am I hesitating...?

<CLT=cltMIND>Am I really going to turn
back now? At a time like this?

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm sure Kaede wants to run away...
But she's still here...she trusts me to do this!

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to answer.
I need to grant her wish.

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to solve
this mystery!
...It's just like Ryoma said.

The shot rolled along the <CLT=cltSTRONG>top of the bookcase<CLT=cltNORMAL>
and fell on Rantaro's head.
It rolled...along the bookcase!?

I did say that...but would the shot
have rolled that conveniently?

It has nothing to do with convenience.
The shot rolled <CLT=cltSTRONG>exactly how<CLT=cltNORMAL> the culprit wanted.

They used <CLT=cltSTRONG>books on top of the bookcases<CLT=cltNORMAL>
to direct the path of the shot.

The shot's path was directed by books?
How would that even work?

Ah, it would be easier to explain
with a floor plan of the library...

<CLT=cltMIND>...Oh, that's right...
Someone did have a floor plan.

<CLT=cltMIND>In fact...that might be
concrete proof of my theory.
Kirumi Tojo

Hey, Kirumi...
Do you have a floor plan of the scene?

My apologies, I do not. I've disgraced myself
as a maid by not meeting your expectations.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up; they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Keebo

Hey, Keebo...
Do you have a floor plan of the scene?

Huh...? I apologize but I am not equipped
with such a function...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up; they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Miu Iruma
Um...
Was there a floor plan?

If there was, I'd think it would've
been presented by now, right?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up; they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>I remember one of them
having a detailed floor plan...
Miu, I recall that during the investigation...

You said you would use your <CLT=cltSTRONG>drone<CLT=cltNORMAL>
to make a <CLT=cltSTRONG>floor plan<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Oh yeah! What happened with that!?

Heh, I've already developed the photos
and drafted some sketches!

Then let's look at it!
Maybe we all find clue!
Please, Miu.

Oh? Want 'em that badly, huh?
Fine...but now you owe me one.
Voila! Feast your eyes on these babies!
<CLT=cltMIND>There it is...
It's just as I thought...
Hm? What is?

See, the books are stacked like <CLT=cltSTRONG>stairs<CLT=cltNORMAL> from the
vent to where Rantaro's body was found.
Oh! Shuichi is right!

Indeed, they are stacked like stairs. I did not 
notice when I looked up from the floor.

I see, I see... The shot rolled
on top of these books, eh?
Yes...I'm sure of it.

The shot was rolled into the classroom
vent and came out in the library.

If the vent was open, the shot would
have maintained momentum.

And you did that, right, Kaede?
You made sure the vent was open.
<CLT=cltMIND>I pushed the grate into the duct...
<CLT=cltMIND>...then I lifted my body and looked inside.
So how's it look? Could a person fit in there?

Hmmm...it would be pretty difficult, but you
might be able to crawl through.

Impressive... You have a really good
memory, Shuichi.

When the shot came through, the stacked books
made it change direction.
It then rolled down the path made by the books.

The books were stacked in rows so that the shot
wouldn't fall off.

At the same time, the books blocked the shot
from view.

Then, when the ball was directly above
Rantaro, it changed direction...

...rolled along the groove of the open
books, and fell on top of his head.

And it was the camera flash that lured him
to that exact spot.

A setup that complicated is almost
like a Rube Goldberg machine.
So Kaede created this mechanism?
Well, it would be—

Wait! Even with a Rube-whatever setup, 
when did she roll the ball into the duct?

That's right! Wasn't Shuichi with Kaede
in the classroom?

<CLT=cltMIND>When did Kaede
roll the shot put ball...?

<CLT=cltMIND>It had to have been
at just the right time to kill Rantaro.
When she entered the classroom

<CLT=cltMIND>No, that would have been
too early. It must be a later time...

Umm... If even Shuichi doesn't know
then I think we're in trouble.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up; they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
When Shuichi went to the basement

<CLT=cltMIND>The air duct isn't that long.
It had to have been when Rantaro was close.

Since you spent the most time with Kaede,
Shuichi, perhaps only you know the answer.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up; they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
When she was leaving the classroom

Hey don't clam up now! You said it,
so you gotta know the answer!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up; they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
<CLT=cltMIND>Kaede rolled the shot...
The moment we <CLT=cltSTRONG>ran out of the classroom<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

When the sensor went off, I ran out first,
and then Kaede followed.
But just before she left...
Sh-Shuichi, the receiver!

Someone moved the bookcase!
Hurry, Kaede!

<CLT=cltMIND>Shuichi sprinted out of the classroom with the
determination of a true <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltMIND>.
W-Wait for me!

<CLT=cltMIND>I dropped everything I was holding and
ran after Shuichi.
I'm right... Aren't I, Kaede?

Of course the Ultimate Detective would
remember all that.

Your words and that smile...
Is this your admission of guilt?

Hold on! Don't just jump to conclusions! 
I've...still got a lot of questions!

Nee-heehee...that's weeeeeird.
Why do you sound so desperate?
There's nothing weird about it!

There's just no way I can believe someone 
like Kaede would be the culprit!
Y-Yeah! Gonta not believe it, either!
What?

Don't worry, Kaede!
I'll clear your name!
